title: Network Anonymiser
description: Upload a power-network JSON or CSV. Replaces bus / station / site names with deterministic codes (B01, B02, …) so the data can be shared with vendors, students, or in published material. Outputs the anonymised file plus a mapping table for de-anonymisation.

blocks.text: All processing is in your browser — neither the original data nor the mapping ever leaves your machine. Keep the mapping table somewhere you can find it later if you need to relate a published result back to the original site.
Set the prefix to something short and stable (e.g. site code letters). The same input value always maps to the same code within a single run.
The tool only renames declared fields — it doesn't search for site names embedded in free-text fields like description or comments. Sweep those manually before sharing.
